**Context Note: Marrow & Vine – Campaign Planning Headquarters (Final Summary)**

The board game *Marrow & Vine* is a medium-weight strategy game centered on harvest-folklore, player-driven tension, and a handcrafted aesthetic. The project is self-published, with a crowdfunding campaign scheduled for launch in five months. All decisions, constraints, and naming conventions established through this conversation are binding and intended for long-term consistency.

**Final Decisions Made:**
- The **component tier** is locked as **Version 2**: standard box with punchboard tokens and a folding board. This was selected over the card-only (Version 1) and resin miniatures (Version 3) editions due to superior playtest feedback, cost efficiency, and tactile engagement. The base game’s per-unit weight is estimated at **1.8 lbs**, including box, cards, tokens, and board.
- **No AI-generated art** is permitted in any form — not for prototypes, ads, or placeholders. All artwork must be hand-crafted and human-led.
- **No campaign-exclusive content** will be created. All components, expansions, and variants are designed to be reprintable and accessible to late-arriving fans and retail buyers.
- **The "Ember"** refers exclusively to the **official two-player duel variant**, not the fan-developed solo automa mode. This term is used only for the core dueling mechanic.
- **"The pledge"** refers exclusively to the **bulk retailer pledge level**, not backer tiers. It is used for volume-based pricing, print run planning, and retail contract discussions.
- **The cover** is final: a night-market scene with twin foxes bartering under paper lanterns, as designed by Kenji. No further changes or revisions are permitted.
- **Kenji must deliver print-ready files 30 days before campaign launch** to ensure timely proofing, printing, and fulfillment.

**Open Threads & Next Steps:**
- Finalize manufacturing quotes by 90 days before launch.
- Begin shipping cost modeling using the 1.8 lb per-unit weight.
- Build a 15% buffer into all shipping charge estimates to absorb mid-campaign rate increases.
- Finalize the base game’s per-unit cost, including materials, printing, and packaging, by Month 3.
- Begin drafting the campaign’s "story" and "why" narrative, using the harvest-folklore theme and the Ember duel as emotional anchors.

**Defined Terms:**
- **Ember**: The official two-player duel variant.
- **The pledge**: The bulk retailer order level (e.g., 500–1,000 units).
- **"The cover"**: The final night-market artwork by Kenji.
- **"The pledge"**: Not to be confused with backer tiers.
- **"No exclusives"**: No campaign-only content, variants, or limited editions.

**Constraints & Preferences:**
- No AI art, no exclusives, no banner ads, no printer shortcuts.
- All components must be reprintable and accessible to future fans.
- No paid banner advertising — only organic, community-driven outreach.

**Options Tried and Ruled Out:**
- **Banner ads**: $210 spent on a hobby forum — 3 clicks, 1 of which was self. Ruled out permanently.
- **PrintForge**: Failed proof run with misaligned die cuts and ruined tokens. Permanently removed from consideration.
- **AI-generated art**: Considered as a cost saver — ruled out due to soullessness and community backlash.
- **Version 1 (card-only)**: Too minimal; failed to engage players emotionally.
- **Version 3 (resin miniatures)**: Too expensive, fragile, and overkill for core gameplay.

**Approaches Used:**
- Playtesting: 30+ sessions with 10–15 blind playtests conducted to validate rulebook clarity and mechanic balance.
- Art brief: Created with a vivid, emotional core (harvest-folklore, hand-painted memory) to guide Kenji.
- Shipping: 15% buffer built into all estimates to protect margins against rate hikes.
- Production: Barcode prefix 0863921 registered and assigned to all SKUs.

All future communication must reference this document for consistency, clarity, and continuity.

- **Marrow & Vine** is a medium-weight strategy board game centered on harvest-folklore, player-driven tension, and a deep thematic aesthetic. The game is being self-published with a crowdfunding campaign scheduled for launch in five months.

- **Final Component Tier:** The standard box with punchboard tokens and a folding board has been locked in. This version was selected over the card-only edition (too minimal, low player engagement in playtests) and the deluxe edition with resin miniatures (too expensive, overkill, and not supported by playtest feedback). This tier offers the best balance of cost, tactile quality, and gameplay depth.

No changes or alternate versions will be considered. This image is the sole cover for all future printings, digital versions, and promotional materials.

- **“The pledge”** refers exclusively to the **bulk retailer pledge level** (e.g., 500–1,000 units), not backer tiers. This distinction is critical for pricing, volume planning, and retail negotiations.

- **“Ember”** refers only to the **official two-player duel variant**. The solo automa mode developed by a fan is not to be called “Ember” in any official context. This term is reserved for the core strategic clash between two players.

- **No campaign-exclusive content** will be created. All components, expansions, and variants are designed to be reprintable and accessible to late-arriving fans and retail buyers.

- **PrintForge** has been permanently removed from consideration after proof copies arrived with misaligned die cuts and ruined tokens. No future production will use this vendor.

- **Barcode prefix 0863921** has been registered and will be used for all future SKUs (e.g., base game: 0863921-001; expansion: 0863921-002). All future components must begin with this prefix.

- **Ocean freight estimate** for the full print run to the US warehouse is $4,860 (baseline). This will be updated monthly and used as a reference point in budgeting.

- **Manufacturing quotes** must be finalized 60–90 days before campaign launch. Initial quotes were requested 120 days out; final quotes are due 90 days out.

- **Kenji’s cover files** must be delivered **30 days before campaign launch** to allow for proofing, color validation, and pre-press setup.

- **Shipping buffer:** A 15% buffer has been built into all final shipping cost estimates to protect against mid-campaign rate increases. This buffer is not a profit margin but a risk mitigation tool.

- **Banner advertising** on hobby forums has been ruled out after a $210 test yielded only three clicks (one from the designer). No future paid banner ads will be used.

- **Playtest data** from 30+ sessions has been analyzed and used to finalize mechanics, rulebook clarity, and component design.

- **No AI-generated art** is allowed — not even for prototypes, placeholders, or ad variations.

- **The standard box tier** is expected to weigh approximately 1.8 lbs per unit (including box, cards, tokens, and folding board). This is the baseline for all shipping and logistics modeling.

- **Next steps:** Finalize printer quotes (90 days out), begin final art proofing (60 days out), update shipping model with 15% buffer, and begin community seeding via storytelling and organic content.
